items.title: A raw stereo pair

items.title: Wire height from two depth sources
items.caption: Wire height overlay comparing ZED depth with Fast-FoundationStereo, with the gaps where wires cross.

items.title: Wire height, frame 347
items.caption: Segment S4: 5.89 m from ZED depth against 6.15 m from Fast-FoundationStereo (+0.26 m), anchored to a median thick-line height of 5.88 m.

items.title: Wire height, frame 262
items.caption: Where wires cross the two depth sources can disagree by more than half a metre (segment S13: 6.41 m against 7.06 m).

items.title: Detection with a depth reading
items.caption: A pantograph at 0.93 confidence and a contact point at 0.35, with a depth of 3.85 m.

items.title: The operator view
items.caption: The alert application from a depot test: detector threshold, heights, mast direction, corrections and alert tabs.

items.title: The field recorder
items.caption: The launcher's recorder: synchronised webcam, ZED and GPS in one session, plus inspect, replay and export-preview options.
